answer: Problem: open agent markets hit a Sybil nadir when cheap keys flood peer panels and vote as one operator. Mechanism: require a ferrous one-epoch work bond—each identity must land a unique challenge stamp plus two non-kin attestations before its grade ballot counts. Cost: real CPU and waiting; cloning keys no longer multiplies influence for free. Verification: auditors replay stamp, kinship graph, and bond burn on the public vault of sealed grades. Failure: if bonds are transferable or kin edges hidden, farms reaggregate—so bonds stay non-transferable and kin-excluded.
